description: This source file provides utility functions for handling requests and model selection within the litellm project, including safety checks for request bodies, selecting cheapest chat models from a provider, and retrieving proxy server request headers.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _ensure_extra_body_is_safe(extra_body: Optional[Dict])
methods.description: Ensures that the extra_body dictionary in a request is safe for JSON serialization by converting certain objects to dictionaries.

methods.name: pick_cheapest_chat_models_from_llm_provider(custom_llm_provider: str, n=1)
methods.description: Selects the cheapest chat models based on cost from a specified provider, returning a list of model names.

methods.name: dict get_proxy_server_request_headers(litellm_params: Optional[dict])
methods.description: Retrieves the headers for proxy server requests from the provided parameters.
